Website packages

Three levels. Here is what each one actually includes.

Every package covers discovery, design, build, testing and launch. What changes between levels is depth: how much design is custom, how much content we shape, and how much strategy sits behind it. The table below shows the difference side by side.

Business Base

$2,499

One-time

For a business that needs a credible, correct website fast — a solid professional presence with nothing missing.

  • Up to 5 pages, structure planned with you
  • Professional template customized to your brand
  • Mobile-responsive layout on every page
  • Working contact form
  • Basic on-page SEO (titles, descriptions, headings)
  • Two consolidated revision rounds
  • Clean, straightforward navigation

Discovery: guided intake questionnaire · Design: template adaptation

Business Growth Most chosen

$4,499

One-time · proposed pricing

For a business with competitors in the same search results that needs to look established, prove its work and capture leads properly.

  • Up to 10 pages, including expanded service pages
  • More customized visual design — real layout, spacing and type decisions, not just color swaps
  • Testimonials section and project gallery
  • Lead capture with routing to the right inbox or person
  • Analytics setup so you can see what works
  • Three consolidated revision rounds

Discovery: guided intake plus a positioning conversation · Design: custom layout applied to your brand

Business Premier

From $7,999

Starting price · proposed pricing

For a business where the website is the primary sales asset — premium positioning, a considered narrative and a qualified inquiry before anyone picks up the phone.

  • Up to 15 pages
  • Distinctive high-end design built from scratch for your business
  • Premium visual storytelling — page-by-page composition and pacing
  • Sophisticated animations used sparingly
  • Interactive multi-step inquiry forms
  • Carefully scoped integrations with established services
  • Clear written project acceptance criteria before work begins

Discovery: structured discovery and content strategy session · Design: original art direction

What no package includes as standard

None of these are part of a package price. If you need one, we scope it and quote it separately before any work starts — always in writing, so there is no surprise on the invoice.

  • Custom web applications
  • Bespoke databases
  • Customer or member portals
  • Advanced ecommerce (cart, inventory, shipping)
  • Unlimited or open-ended integrations
  • Ongoing content writing or monthly retainer work

Hosting, domains and third-party subscriptions are billed by their own providers and are not included. Social media management, branding and business automation are separate services — ask about them in your inquiry.
